name: Joshua V Callahan

bio.statement: The Happy Valley city council page lists Callahan as council president, Position 1, with a term expiring December 31, 2026.
Callahan's pamphlet statement lists a JD from Lewis & Clark Law School and a criminology BA from Portland State University.
bio.excerpt: JD - Lewis & Clark Law School, BA (Criminology); Portland State University (Cum Laude); Rex Putnam HS Graduate

bio.statement: Callahan's pamphlet statement describes him as a small business owner and combat veteran.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Callahan says the city's biggest priority should be its public safety program.
positions.excerpt: I believe our city’s biggest priority should be our public safety program.

positions.statement: Callahan's pamphlet statement says he will work to keep Happy Valley one of the safest communities in the state.
positions.excerpt: I will work tirelessly to ensure the residents of Happy Valley continue to have one of the safest communities in our state.

positions.statement: Callahan's pamphlet statement describes Happy Valley as one of the lowest-taxing cities in the state.
positions.excerpt: Happy Valley is one of the lowest taxing cities in the state.

positions.statement: Callahan's pamphlet statement says Happy Valley is not, in his view, a metropolitan city.
positions.excerpt: Happy Valley is not a metropolitan city in my view.
